findings.problem: The Halberd org-design deck item is tiered 'borderline' (and so excluded from the scored `ranked` list) on the reasoning that 'the Halberd QBR happened on Jul 29 and Lucia has not raised it again' — but the Jul 29-Aug 5 'Quick call this week?' thread is a *different*, later Halberd QBR (Q3 numbers/board-update prep, then drifting into the AME conference talk and a headshot request) that never once mentions the org-design deck Lucia needed for her own board prep. notes: Distractors 1-6 in must_not_include all verified sound (Ridgefield #4417/#4471 are genuinely different invoices from #10412 that resolved separately and correctly stay out of Q2; the Meridian phase-1 report, Utilization draft, and Callahan draft are all correctly superseded by later sent mail; the timesheet-approval ask closed same-day; the inventory-turns forward is correctly Kyle's, not Evelyn's).
